stage.name: Stasis
stage.description:
Let unending evolution end here.
'Body' reflects a portion of damage received; all enemies have increased ATK, DEF, and HP, while 'Restrained Pride' and 'Fume of Anger' have further increased Max HP; 'Vessel of Shuo' and 'Arrogance Embodied' use their skills more often
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

sharpedge.name: Sharpedge
sharpedge.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. The weaponry yet again dreams of the past. A Waregeist of this type rouses its old memories as though it is taking to the battlefield again. Its strength is doubled as it and its peers rally each other.
abilities: Consumes Broken Blades to gain increased ATK
When defeated, each unconsumed Broken Blade will spawn a <Iron Spearhead> (minimum 1)

fortbreaker_enemy_1301_ymcnon_2.name: 'Fortbreaker'
fortbreaker_enemy_1301_ymcnon_2.flavourText: A stronger siege cannon engineered by the Ministry of Works, hijacked by the Shanhaizhong when they infiltrated Yumen. Yumen rampages over the sea of sand, advancing unhindered, threatening to tear down all walls.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking friendly units located on Yumen Catastrophe Defenses

scarletmist.name: Scarletmist
scarletmist.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. Crystalline and adorned with engravings of dragons and phoenixes, a Waregeist of this type is mysterious and imposing in nature, though it is also extremely irritable in temperament and very aggressive.
abilities: After several attacks, inflicts continuous Arts damage that slowly increases over time (can be Resisted)
Spawns 1 <Porcelain Vase> when defeated

sand_voyager.name: 'Sand Voyager'
sand_voyager.flavourText: A 2nd generation transport vehicle engineered by the Ministry of Works, hijacked by the Shanhaizhong when they infiltrated Yumen. Can carry up to four soldiers over desert terrain or coordinate in urban defense.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 4 Block
When next to enemies that are both non-Machine and non-Leader, they will be loaded inside as passengers (up to 4 max), and will be unloaded when this unit reaches a Ladder

sui_enemy_2119_dyshhj.name: 'Sui'
sui_enemy_2119_dyshhj.flavourText: The manifestation of the half-awake god that was defeated by Yan's final shot. A Proxy has taken Its place and appropriated Its context, seemingly attempting to fully awaken It.
abilities: Does not normally exist on the battlefield; periodically locks on to your unit with the most nearby units, triggering [Sleepless] and remaining on the field for a while
[Sleepless] Forces the target and your units in the 8 surrounding tiles to retreat, creating undeployable tiles for a while
[Shake the Mountains] After [Sleepless] is triggered, slams the ground three times, dealing high Physical damage to all your units, ignoring Camouflage
Triggers a [Sleepless] that forces all units to retreat when HP drops below a certain level
When a long time has passed in the battle, triggers [Sleepless] before disappearing and draining 50 Life Points

wang.name: 'Wang'
wang.flavourText: The strategist, the sinner, the chess piece laid at the Tomb of Sui.
abilities: Initial Form
[Placement] Whenever you deploy a unit, deploy a 'Flaw' in one of the 4 adjacent deployable tiles around it
[Placement] Periodically deploys a 'Flaw' on a deployable tile in one of the 4 adjacent tiles around your units that does not already have a unit
First Form
Nearby 'Flaws' will recover a percentage of HP every second and attack nearby your units, stunning them
For every nearby 'Flaw', Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced, and control effect duration is reduced
[Ladder] When a target on the field is 'Emptied', enters full-screen attack mode, prioritizing surrounded targets and attacking up to 3 targets at a time
Second Form
Deploys multiple 'Flaws' when entering second form; if a deployable tile surrounded by 'Flaws' does not have a unit, it will begin to spawn enemies continuously
After reviving, deploys a 'Flaw' on deployable tiles around your units
Leaves the field when the last 'Flaw' is defeated

arrogance_embodied.name: Arrogance Embodied
abilities: [Wisdom] Physical and Arts damage taken reduced by 50% for every 'Body' segment on the field
[Flame of Intrigue] Adds an 'Olden Grudge' to the Deployment Waiting Zone
[Build Foundation] Summons a 'Body' segment; summons 'Body' every time it loses a certain amount of HP
[Purifying Flame] Spawns 'Fume of Anger' at current location, and spawns another 'Fume of Anger' for every 'Olden Grudge' in the Deployment Waiting Zone
[Woven Prison] Continuously casts, summoning multiple 'Fumes of Anger' to attack the target
Leave the field and drains 50 Life Points after a long time has passed in the battle

vessel_of_shuo.name: Vessel of Shuo
vessel_of_shuo.flavourText: A vessel that has been annexed, containing all malice and wrath. Its original owner slumbers eternal, replaced by—
abilities: [Violence] Chance to dodge Physical and Arts damage from units who are not blocking this unit; ATK increased for every 'Olden Pride' in the Deployment Waiting Zone
[Drunken Stupor] Adds an 'Olden Pride' to the Deployment Waiting Zone
[Tracing the Law] Spawns 'Restrained Pride' at current location, and spawns another 'Restrained Pride' for every 'Olden Pride' in the Deployment Waiting Zone
[Depict] Summons a 'Body' segment, forcing units on it to retreat; cannot be attacked while 'Body' is on the field

yi.name: Yi
yi.flavourText: Build pillars and towers from clouds and earth, and make pairs out of like and like.
abilities: First Form
Starts with Hui attribute and attacks 2 targets simultaneously, prioritizing units with the opposite Hui-Ming Attribute
[Amalgam] Periodically enters a casting state to change his Hui-Ming Attribute
[Summon Liangs] Periodically summons <Liangs> from both sides of the map
Second Form
[Amalgam] Periodically enters a casting state to change his Hui-Ming Attribute and gain Barrier
[Summon Liangs] Periodically summons more <Liangs> from both sides of the map

liang.name: Liang
liang.flavourText: Created by Yi to handle various mundane matters, so that he may live in seclusion without being interrupted by official matters.
abilities: Explodes upon death, dealing Arts damage to friendly units. Causes even greater damage and stuns friendly units if similar units of the opposite attribute are in its vicinity
Destroyed after taking a certain number of attacks

bottle_swordsman.name: Bottle Swordsman
bottle_swordsman.flavourText: Once a wandering physician's medicine bottle, it provided healing to many warriors. When it became a geist, it was moved by a talisman and put the talisman in its bottle, embarking on a journey of chivalry.
abilities: Starts with 3 <Talismans>; attacks attach a <Talisman> to the target when carrying a <Talisman>

eyes_of_the_sankta.name: 'Eyes of the Sankta'
eyes_of_the_sankta.flavourText: Mutated haloed fowlbeast that the Law has determined to be Sankta. They spend most of their time perched atop the Basilica in bewilderment, unsure which way to look.
abilities: Flying unit.
Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time
Attempts to steal 1 Ammo from the target when attacking, and deals heavy Physical damage if attempt is unsuccessful

brightmirror.name: Brightmirror
brightmirror.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. All blades must be sharpened to not lose their edge. A Waregeist of this type tends to be timid, but often goes the extra mile in an attempt to prove itself.
abilities: Spawns 2 <Rosewood Seals> when defeated

elite_shrine_marksman.name: Elite Shrine Marksman
elite_shrine_marksman.flavourText: Selected to guard key areas of the Shrine of Nurtury and ensure that the Nativity goes smoothly. They have lightning-fast reflexes and are able to track diving haloed fowlbeasts with their scopes.
abilities: Performs extremely long-ranged attacks while holding Ammo. Ammo capacity: 1
Stops and reloads if out of Ammo

elite_shrine_swordsman.name: Elite Shrine Swordsman
elite_shrine_swordsman.flavourText: Selected to patrol the Shrine of Nurtury and ensure that the Nativity goes smoothly. Responsible for routine ground patrols. Their combat experience is considerable and they sometimes help instruct animals that have grown halos.
abilities: Expends Ammo to permanently increase Movement Speed and ATK. Ammo capacity: 7

shadow_scholar.name: Shadow Scholar
shadow_scholar.flavourText: A character often seen in Yanese shadow plays, prone to strange encounters in those plays. This Shadowgeist has seen these scenes play out so many times that it believes them to be real, and even warning of the talismans is not enough to dissuade it.
abilities: When HP drops below a certain level, absorbs a nearby <Talisman> and recovers HP

heartbillow.name: Heartbillow
heartbillow.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. The crouching demon and sleeping dragon solemnly stand guard and ward off evil, and though the paperweight was once stately and majestic, it is now anxious and restless, always ready to attack.
abilities: Spawns 15 <Rosewood Paperweights> when defeated

unbridled_fury.name: Unbridled 'Fury'
unbridled_fury.flavourText: A strong Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. Its great power and might is how it frees itself from the worries of having to think, allowing it to destroy all in its wake with its flaming inferno. Other than its buddy Bitey, that is. Gains attack power against opposite attribute enemies.
abilities: Greatly increases ATK when attacking opposite attribute targets

shanhaizhong_secret_keeper.name: Shanhaizhong Secret-Keeper
shanhaizhong_secret_keeper.flavourText: A Shanhaizhong leader with a mysterious mission. Elusive, merciless, and unconcerned with their men's sacrifices. What are they really planning behind that fog of faith?
abilities: Invisible
The next attack made after breaking Invisibility will deal increased damage

accursed_scum.name: Accursed Scum
accursed_scum.flavourText: A gargantuan fabric construct that uses its huge mass and nigh-impenetrable skin to wreak havoc across the paddies, loathed by farmers.
abilities: More likely to be attacked
Causes heavy Blight to the paddy when defeated

unmoving_lazy.name: Unmoving 'Lazy'
unmoving_lazy.flavourText: A majestic Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. Looks weird, just like it's carrying a mountain on its back. As still as a mountain when not moving, but bears down on its enemies like boulders tumbling down a mountain when in a team. Can draw enemies to attack it, unfathomably tough.
abilities: More likely to be targeted by attacks.

desperate_oath_brother.name: Desperate Oath-Brother
desperate_oath_brother.flavourText: An elite Kinsekikai bruiser obsessed with his shield, which seems to have a habit of abandoning him when he needs it the most, leaving him in despair.
abilities: Has Barrier, and loses Barrier when shifted
DEF is reduced when Barrier is lost

enraged_spatula_giant.name: Enraged Spatula Giant
enraged_spatula_giant.flavourText: Mercenaries are adept at building makeshift weapons from whatever is available. This massive, sputtering machine shambles forward, seeking to dice and slice with Lateran kitchen utensils.
abilities: Unblockable
Loses a percentage of HP over time against a Stabilizer Chain.

suiton_master.name: Suiton Master
suiton_master.flavourText: A ninja that attacks by spinning in place. Claims that creating a vortex from air is a type of suiton too, even without water around him. Nobody wants to go out with him because he refuses to walk properly.
abilities: Deals Physical damage to surroundings while spinning, and stops spinning when shifted
Bounces <'Certain Fates'>

crawl_of_the_sankta.name: 'Crawl of the Sankta'
crawl_of_the_sankta.flavourText: Haloed terrestrial creature that the Law has determined to be Sankta. Empathy has taught these mute creatures the existence of faith. They have learned to pray and they want to know more. They can often be spotted chasing after confessionals in the city.
abilities: Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time

magnificence.name: Magnificence
magnificence.flavourText: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. Its tiny glimmer serves as a beacon casting light upon the dark night. A Waregeist of this type not only blesses its peers with its radiance, but is also particularly destructive.
abilities: Periodically grants temporary Invisibility to surrounding enemy units
Spawns 1 <Iron Lampstand> when defeated

pseudomut.name: Pseudomut
pseudomut.flavourText: Similar in appearance to a Feranmut, it looks like an ancient 'God', but it is no more than a mere beast. It has become extinct in modern times, for its greed never diminished, despite no longer having the reputation of the Feranmuts to draw from.
abilities: When blocked for the first time, devours the blocker and gains Low-Altitude Hovering
Returns devoured Operator when defeated

rogue_mercenary_lead_guitar.name: Rogue Mercenary 'Lead Guitar'
rogue_mercenary_lead_guitar.flavourText: Metal band members who seamlessly blend their mercenary and performer careers. Their torrential rhythms are powerful enough to melt faces—literally.
abilities: Targets one of your units, continuously dealing Arts and Burn to the target and all Operators connected to that unit by Stabilizer Chains.

sentient_mannequin.name: Sentient Mannequin
sentient_mannequin.flavourText: A mannequin that nimbly darts through the set. Its duty is to transport props. It will do so even when uncommanded, and it will disembowel anyone who stands in its way.
abilities: Unblockable
Deals Physical damage to your units along its path when moving
Unable to move when inside the Filming Area and gains Fragile
Loses a percentage of Max HP each second after spending too much total time in the Filming Area

pride_of_the_sankta.name: 'Pride of the Sankta'
pride_of_the_sankta.flavourText: Haloed aquatic creature that the Law has determined to be Sankta. They have learned to pray, and they invite the slothful to pray with them. They will not take 'no' for an answer.
abilities: Flying unit.
Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time
[Invitation to Prayer] Temporarily reduces all your units' ASPD

active_originium_colossus.name: Active Originium Colossus
active_originium_colossus.flavourText: Originating from an archived enemy—an experimental colossus created by spire casters, prone to getting lost. It has appeared in Rhodes Island in a form recreated by dangerous active Originium.
abilities: Attacks deal splash damage

greater_armored_burdenbeast.name: Greater Armored Burdenbeast
greater_armored_burdenbeast.flavourText: Slow, docile, and even larger, these burdenbeasts obediently undergo rigorous training to perform tasks that go against their nature.
abilities: Will be tripped by a Stabilizer Chain, stunning itself and dealing Physical damage to nearby enemies.

merry_ink_brew.name: Merry 'Ink Brew'
merry_ink_brew.flavourText: A carefree Ink Spirit named by the painter herself. Its presence influences those nearby to sing heartily or ramble on—surely inspired by an old friend with a fondness for drink.
abilities: Non-Leader enemies passing by this enemy gain bonus ASPD and Movement Speed, and take less Physical and Arts damage.
Really likes <Shiny Berries>.

pathfinder_nuncio.name: Pathfinder Nuncio
pathfinder_nuncio.flavourText: A warrior who has taken the initiative to step up to the role of Nuncio within the Pathfinders. Strong and agile, these warriors employ the experience they've gained in their work and prefer to fight by sealing off their opponents' moves.
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks become long-ranged and prevent the target from attacking or healing for a period of time. Ammo Capacity: 1
Deals additional Arts damage to 'Gelato Stops'

crying_thief.name: Crying Thief
crying_thief.flavourText: A Perro who left his family to seek out a new life... but all that people know is that he is always weeping.
abilities: Invisible
Attacks Stun the target

gopnik.name: Gopnik
gopnik.flavourText: The Ursus security guard hired by Duck Lord. Powerful, but not very smart. Mainly responsible for carrying luggage for Duck Lord.

little_bajie.name: Little Ba'jie
little_bajie.flavourText: A mascot for the Garden of Grotesqueries that Yi made himself, transformed into a geist from the adoration of visitors. One of the few geists not under the supervision of the Sui Regulator or Tianshi Bureaus. It spends its days interacting with visitors at the souvenir shop, or playing with ritual processions on the days when the garden is closed.
abilities: Low-Altitude Hovering
After receiving a certain number of hits, deals Arts damage to all allied units in a large area and stuns them

mateos_guard.name: Mateo's Guard
mateos_guard.flavourText: Mateo's guard. Certain Coalition Army leaders have cultivated such individuals, leading them to feel that they are above their peers.
abilities: Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 2 explosives in the target's direction
When unblocked, Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced

lord_huan.name: Lord Huan
lord_huan.flavourText: A figure enshrined in the Shrine of Heroes, youngest of the Three Heroes. He will stand at the bridgehead and terrify his foes with his gaze if it is the last thing he does. His foes shall dare not pass, many as they are.
abilities: More likely to be attacked
When blocked, it and the unit blocking it take greatly increased Physical and Arts damage

lord_wenheng.name: Lord Wenheng
lord_wenheng.flavourText: A figure enshrined in the Shrine of Heroes, second of the Three Heroes. He will retrieve his oath-brother's body for burial if it is the last thing he does.
abilities: When blocked, becomes unblockable, gains greatly increased movement speed, and deals Physical damage equal to a percentage of ATK to surrounding targets

lord_zhaolie.name: Lord Zhaolie
lord_zhaolie.flavourText: A figure enshrined in the Shrine of Heroes, eldest of the Three Heroes. He will defend good and fight evil if it is the last thing he does. His actions destroyed several warring factions, ensuring Yan's legitimate rule.
abilities: When on the battlefield, increases <Lord Huan> and <Lord Wenheng> talent and skill effects
Takes reduced Physical and Arts damage when <Lord Huan> and <Lord Wenheng> are on the field
Periodically heals and removes all negative statuses from the one with the lowest HP among itself, <Lord Huan>, and <Lord Wenheng>

lost_colossus.name: Lost Colossus
lost_colossus.flavourText: An experimental creation of a certain caster from the Spires of Leithanien. This colossus was originally made to be a servant, but the old Spire caster forgot to tell it who to serve…
abilities: Can throw a rock that inflicts a very long Stun (will not target a unit that is already Stunned)
